title: Add trade completion celebration modal with mutual review prompt — retention/engagement
description: When both parties mark a trade as mutually completed, show a celebration modal that congratulates them and prompts both to leave a review. Reuse the existing ratings system (ratings table + getRatingsForProfile). Add a TradeCompletionCelebration component that appears on the conversation page after mutual completion, with CTAs to rate the other party and share the success. Track trade_completion_celebrated and review_prompt_dismissed in PostHog. Add a server action to create the rating from the modal. Acceptance: modal shows only once per trade, review form submits via existing ratings action, celebration is dismissible, and tests cover visibility + submission.
notes: Added TradeCompletionCelebration modal component with PartyPopper icon, star rating, review form, localStorage dismissal tracking, and PostHog analytics. Wired into message thread page. 9 unit tests covering visibility, dismissal, star selection, and form fields. Commit: b2f8aff.

title: Add member testimonials section to landing page — growth/acquisition
description: Create a testimonials table (profile_id, quote, trade_context, created_at, is_featured) with RLS. Add an admin-reviewed submission flow where members can submit a testimonial after completing a trade. Display 3-5 featured testimonials on the landing page below the HowItWorks section. Track testimonial_page_viewed and testimonial_cta_clicked in PostHog. Acceptance: testimonials render on landing page, submission is gated to members with completed trades, admin can feature/unfeature, and tests cover rendering + submission.

title: Add Premium preview toggle on listing detail pages for free members — revenue/monetization
description: Show a 'Preview Premium' banner on listing detail pages for free members that toggles a simulated Premium view: featured badge styling, verified badge, and a 'Your listing could look like this' CTA. Use CSS-only preview (no data changes). Track premium_preview_toggled and premium_preview_cta_clicked in PostHog. Acceptance: toggle only shows for free members, preview is visually distinct, CTA links to /dashboard/billing, and tests cover visibility + toggle behavior.
notes: Started implementation: need to inspect listing detail page and existing Premium/Free member detection.
